paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar cooling bound from R2 parameter (AGB/HB ratio) in globular clusters using MESA simulations. Main constraint g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 (semiconvection scheme), valid for ALP masses ~O(1e-6) to O(1) eV (encoded as horizontal line). An improved projection of 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 from asteroseismology is also mentioned but not adopted as the primary bound. Mass-independent astrophysical bound; no DM density assumption. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
